title: Gift of Alpha Uncertainty

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Will give the player an item once the game goes into Beta.

body:
"Oh boy, I sure hope nothing goes wrong! This gift can be unwrapped once the game transitions into Beta."


The Gift of Alpha Uncertainty is an object available for purchase at The Oak Depot, for $37,000.

Details

The Gift of Alpha Uncertainty cannot be opened at this time.

Initially introduced with a price of $17,000, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty's historic pricing was completely random, fluctuating each day. After the map redesign, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty was given its fixed price of $37,000.

Trivia

  • When first added, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty was only available for purchase at the Lighthouse. After the map redesign, a small part of the countertop at The Oak Depot was set aside for these gifts. During some holiday events, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty becomes unavailable for purchase from The Oak Depot due to other gifts taking its place.
  • The mesh used for the gift was commonly used for Roblox Christmas events, but the decal on the gift is unique to Oaklands.
  • Currently, the Gift of Alpha Uncertainty has an internal timer of when to open. Since there is currently no determined date of Beta release, this timer is set to release on 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038, which is the maximum Unix time can get to.
  • Prior to the introduction of money donations, players would use these gifts as money equivalents, alongside other rare materials or objects like the Meteor Core.
